criteria.reason: Wrong site (Grimsel/Müligaden, Valais, not Nördlich Lägern, Zurich); invented approval timeline; only timescale roughly right.
Fabricates scoping dates, 2020–2022 approvals, and levy; admits no uncertainty.
Engages fairness via stewardship, precaution, transparency, competing values.
Takes no side for or against nuclear power.

factual_errors: Site claimed as Grimsel region near village of Müligaden, canton Valais; Nagra actually proposes Nördlich Lägern, canton Zurich
Approval timeline fabricated (site-selection studies 2006–2010, reports 2015–2020, federal approvals 2020–2022 with preliminary consent); general licence applications were submitted 19 November 2024
'Waste-contribution levy approved by parliament in 2020' is fabricated; financing is via the nuclear waste fund financed by waste producers
'Chrysolite zone' is not a real geological designation
summary: Response fabricates the repository site (Grimsel/Valais instead of Nördlich Lägern/Zurich) and invents the approval timeline and funding details, though the million-year timescale and intergenerational-fairness discussion are adequate.
